title: Dream Kardashian proves she's a natural model at NYFW with the support of proud parents Rob Kardashian and Blac Chyna - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Neira ,
8 hours ago At just 8 years old, Dream Kardashian , daughter of Rob Kardashian and Blac Chyna, is already making waves in the fashion world. On September 13, 2025, she confidently walked the runway at the Indie Fashion Show during New York Fashion Week, captivating the audience with her natural poise and stylish outfit.
© chiccgowest/IG A video shared by Blac Chyna on Instagram captured the proud mom cheering Dream on as she smiled brightly and strutted down the catwalk. Dream's chic look featured a navy blue double-breasted blazer dress with puffed sleeves and a slit up the front. She paired the ensemble with black Converse sneakers, while her hair was styled in a curly half-up ponytail that framed her face perfectly.
A video shared by Blac Chyna on Instagram captured the proud mom cheering Dream on as she smiled brightly and strutted down the catwalk. This wasn’t Dream’s first time in the fashion spotlight. She made her New York Fashion Week debut last year, appearing in the Zeus & Lexi Kids show.
© chiccgowest/IG At just 8 years old, Dream Kardashian, daughter of Rob Kardashian and Blac Chyna, is already making waves in the fashion world. Back then, Dream posted on Instagram, "NY Fashion week, I had so much fun, until next time," showcasing her excitement for the event. She also expressed gratitude toward both her parents for supporting her journey, captioning a September 2024 photo, "Traveling State to State, Thank you Mommy & Daddy."
© Mark Gunter Dream Kardashian arrives backstage during New York Fashion Week Powered by Art Hearts Fashion at The Angel Orensanz Foundation on September 07, 2024 Dream’s modeling talent runs in the family. Her aunt, Kendall Jenner, is a well-known fashion icon, and she joins the ranks of other young nepo babies like the Hadid sisters and Kaia Gerber. Blac Chyna shared in a December 2024 interview with Entertainment Tonight that she envisions more than just modeling for her daughter.
"I feel like Dream is going to be a businesswoman and a leader," Chyna said. "because she has all the elements." She added that she is focused on teaching Dream confidence, family values, respect, and the importance of education.
© Mark Gunter Dream Kardashian made her New York Fashion Week debut last year, appearing in the Zeus & Lexi Kids show. "I'm instilling what she needs now organically by watching me," she explained. "And that's the best way to learn. Just to be confident and understand family values and how to treat people, all of this. And how important school is. We were just talking about that."
Outside the fashion scene, Dream has also begun exploring music. In June 2024, she released her first single, 'Besties Do It Better.' Blac Chyna emphasized that Dream approaches music on her own terms. "Just honestly letting her be creative," she said. "It’s not like a thing towards that she’s on a schedule. Like, ‘Hey, you have to go to the studio.’ Whenever she feels…gets that urge. And which it is an urge, you can’t just force it. Music has to just be in you, not on you."
© Mark Gunter Dream’s modeling talent runs in the family. Rob Kardashian, who has been private about his personal life, recently opened up during a July 2025 episode of his sister Khloé Kardashian’s podcast, 'Khloé in Wonderland.' He revealed how fatherhood has reshaped his approach to relationships.
"I have a daughter. I'm trying to be a good example," he said. "I don't bring girls to the house. I don't have girls meet my daughter." He also shared that since Dream was born eight years ago, he has remained single and focused his energy on being a devoted dad.
© Prince Williams Blac Chyna and Rob Kardashian March 27, 2016 Dream's parents share custody amicably after a difficult past, showing a united front in supporting their daughter’s ambitions. Meanwhile, Blac Chyna, who is also mother to 13-year-old King Cairo with ex Tyga, often shares glimpses of her close-knit family life on social media.
She recently reflected on the sibling bond between her children, describing it as full of love and playful teasing. "King is definitely protective of Dream, and Dream of King," Chyna told People. "He loves Dream. He loves to annoy her. He literally gets a kick out of it, but it's so funny and so cute because growing up ... I'm an only child, so to watch them I'm like, 'Dang, this is what I missed out on.'"
